ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: ASRM 450/Stat 420. This course will introduce students to the theory behind supervised and unsupervised data analysis techniques. Topics will cover: the theory behind generalized linear regression (link functions, parameter estimation, testing of hypothesis and model selection criteria); Time series (ARIMA models); Decision trees (Regression and Classification Techniques CART); Data reduction method using principle components; Unsupervised learning technique using cluster analysis. This course will prepare students for the SOA Exam SRM.
